fusions.name: Bars Come Down
fusions.desc: Chops a ring around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: A chop at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage, adding 1.2 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. It leaves the target [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Pen
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Quarry
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises 12%.
